title: Understanding Market Microstructure and Liquidity
description: An advanced, India-specific course on how orders actually become trades on NSE and BSE, and why liquidity, not just price, decides what you really pay. Built for experienced retail investors, active traders and HNI portfolios who have moved beyond stock picking and now need to understand the order book, price-time priority, pre-open and closing auctions, impact cost, slippage, and the hidden footprint of algos, FIIs and block deals. Covers how to read market depth on Zerodha, measure liquidity with NSE impact cost and delivery data, execute large orders without moving the price, and build a liquidity-aware plan for smallcaps and volatile sessions.
